title: An Empirical Survey of the Effectiveness of Debiasing Techniques for Pre-trained Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model representations using the Sentence Encoder Association Test (SEAT) to measure cosine similarity between attribute and target concepts, and calculating stereotype scores based on masked token probabilities for stereotypical versus anti-stereotypical sentences using the StereoSet and CrowS-Pairs benchmarks.
